intelligence.human_view: The machine trusted a PASS as proof, and a PASS measures the fix. The fix can be perfect and the page still broken — the tile was fixed, the wisdom text was still cut off, the frequency was still on every tile, and nobody whose job it was to look at the page looked at the page. His question is not "why did the seat fail" — it is "why did you send it to me when you know my standard." The answer is that the last look before him was nobody's job. Now it is the captain's job, in writing, every time.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine you build a tower and your friend says "the red block is straight" — so you show it to Dad. But the tower is leaning, blocks are missing, and there's a block in the middle nobody asked for. Your friend only checked the red block. From now on, someone checks the WHOLE tower before Dad sees it.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, we sent him a page, dear, because one little fix passed its check, dear — but nobody looked at the whole page, dear, and the whole page was a mess, dear. So now the captain looks at the whole page herself, dear, top to bottom, phone first, dear, before anything goes to him, dear.
intelligence.naya_view: THE CAPTAIN LOOKS FIRST. NO LINK GOES TO HIM ON A SEAT'S PASS ALONE. THE CHECK SCORES THE WHOLE PAGE, NOT THE DIFF.
